provenance: This is the first and only execution of pareto-v1-2026-08-14. Unlike the ood-v1 and function-approx-v1 golden records, there is no earlier published table to reproduce against: the protocol, its config, its evaluator, and its pairing test were committed together at protocol_commit, and this run was executed immediately afterward at the same commit with no code changes in between (git status was clean). This file is the original, canonical record.

runtime_seconds_per_seed.note: Wall-clock runtimes do not reproduce across machines (see E7 in docs/ERRATA.md, recorded against ood-v1). The median matched-pair runtime ratios observed on this machine were 1.098 (dense_2_of_6_tiny_group), 1.098 (needle_5_of_5_long_horizon), 1.074 (threshold_3_of_5_small_group), and 1.080 (threshold_4_of_6_three_actions), all comfortably under the frozen 1.5 feasibility threshold. Only the pass/fail outcome against that threshold should be treated as reproducible, not the ratios themselves.

interpretation: On the four ood-v1 scenarios, across the pre-declared step grid {0.50, 0.75, 1.00, 1.25, 1.50, 1.75, 2.00} and the deterministic smallest-qualifying-step matching rule, Online RC-OMD attained Uniform Group OMD's success AUC within 0.01 while using at most 75% of its absolute distractor KL, at every one of the 28 Uniform step-size settings tested (7 steps x 4 scenarios). This does not support reward improvement at equal nominal step size (separately measured and not supported, E1), generalization to task families outside ood-v1, any claim about shared-parameter function approximation (function-approx-v1 returned NO-GO), or causal credit identification.
note_on_full_evaluation: The complete per-point breakdown (matched step, paired d_AUC with its 95% CI, distractor-KL log-ratio CI, frontier-truncation flag) for all 28 Uniform grid points is in protocol_evaluation.json, referenced above by hash, and is not duplicated in this summary record.
